title: feat(rest): the public form submit answer carries the engine-generated fields its thank-you panel names
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-tesla"} -->
_Requested by **Tesla** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01AXsQkLFKRdQCqQ3RTr6Jao?thread=cmsg_01AXsQkLFKRdQCqQ3RTr6Jao5tKEFLNaFYifAyKCfRo1qW)_

Fixes #28443. This is the server step of #28005 (ruling B, record 6545210989; names approved in record 6548758413). The spec half landed in #28440; the ui half (#28444) follows this one.

Clause-②: yes (widening)
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：匿名公开表单提交接口 `POST /api/v1/forms/:slug/submit` 的回包，除了新记录的 `id`，现在还会带上 `fields`：表单「感谢页」里用 `{{record.字段名}}` 点名的、由引擎在插入时生成的字段值（今天只有自动编号 `autonumber`，比如工单号）。感谢页没点名任何字段的表单，回包仍然只有 `{ id }`。
- 为什么改：web-to-case 这类公开表单，访客提交后需要看到自己的工单号。#28005 裁决 B 定了顺序：spec 先、server 次、ui 后；spec 的名字（`PublicFormSubmitResponseSchema`、`thankYouRecordFieldNames`）已在 #28440 合入，本 PR 是 server 这一步。
- 风险与回滚：这是一次放宽：匿名访客能多看到被点名的自动编号值。插入后存下的其它值（包括提权钩子从访客无权读的记录里算出的值）一律不回。服务端在回包时再按字段的当前类型核对一次，不是自动编号的名字直接丢弃，所以发布后把字段改成文本类型也不会泄露。回滚即 revert 本 PR，回包退回 `{ id }`。
- 先看：`packages/rest/src/form-routes.ts` 的 `thankYouAnswerFields`（两条丢弃规则）和提交处理末尾组装 `answer` 的几行；`packages/rest/src/public-form-submit-answer.test.ts` 新增的 `[#28005]` 一组用例。
- 两分钟验证：`pnpm --filter @objectstack/rest exec vitest run --maxWorkers=2 src/public-form-submit-answer.test.ts`，预期 10 条全绿，其中点名自动编号的表单回包恰为 `{ id, fields: { case_number } }`。
- 需要你做的：无，席位落地。

## What changes

**The answer.** After the insert, the submit handler reads `thankYouRecordFieldNames(match.form.submitBehavior)` (`@objectstack/spec/ui`), the one reading of which names a thank-you panel holds. When it returns at least one name, `thankYouAnswerFields` builds `fields` from the row `createData` answered, and the body is typed `PublicFormSubmitResponse`. A panel with no token, or a form with any other `submitBehavior`, answers `{ id }` exactly as before.

**Two drop rules, applied at answer time.** A named field reaches the answer only if both hold:

1. **Type.** The object's current declaration has the name as a field whose `type` is in `RUNTIME_OWNED_FIELD_TYPES` (`@objectstack/spec/data`, today `autonumber`). A field retyped after publish fails this rule. So does a name that is no declared field: a system column such as `created_at`, a lookup such as `owner_id`, or a prototype key such as `constructor`.
2. **Value.** The answered row carries the name as a string or a number. A name the row lacks is dropped, never answered as `null`: a field masked by the grant's result masker, one stripped as `internal: true`, or one never generated. A `null` or any other shape is dropped too.

`fields` is left out when no name survives. The row is the one `createData` already answered, so this adds no second read. It is stripped of `internal: true` fields and masked for the grant. The object declaration is read at most once per submission: the read the `required` / file / option judgements already make is now shared with the answer through a memo.

**Route ledger.** The `POST /api/v1/forms/:slug/submit` row names `responseSchema: 'PublicFormSubmitResponseSchema'`, with its conformance test cited in the note.

**Comments and docs that stated the answer.** These now say `{ id }` plus the panel-named engine-generated fields:
- the `[#22437]` comment in `form-routes.ts` and the private `registerFormEndpoints` docblock in `rest-server.ts`;
- the internal-fields tripwire disposition. It moves from `no-record-echo` to `protocol-ingress`, because the values come off `createData`'s stripped record;
- `content/docs/ui/forms.mdx` §4 (the success response and the minimal client) and the masker bullet, and `content/docs/ui/public-data-collection.mdx`.

## Tests

`packages/rest/src/public-form-submit-answer.test.ts`, new `[#28005]` block. Every answer is parsed with `PublicFormSubmitResponseSchema` (strict):

- A panel naming an `autonumber` field answers `{ id, fields: { case_number } }`. No other stored value (derived, defaulted, owner, email, timestamps) appears in the serialized body.
- A name in both title and message is answered once.
- A panel with no token answers `{ id }` only.
- Type rule: a field retyped to `text` after publish is dropped. Names that are no declared field (`created_at`), a lookup (`owner_id`) or `constructor` are dropped, and the autonumber beside them is kept.
- Value rule: a name the answered row does not carry is dropped, and so is a stored `null`.
- The ledger row names `PublicFormSubmitResponseSchema`, and that name resolves to the very schema the cases parse with.

`rest-write-response-internal-fields.tripwire.test.ts`: the disposition change above.

Whole package on `ab25d2a7`: `pnpm --filter @objectstack/rest exec vitest run`: `Test Files 363 passed (363)`, `Tests 7166 passed | 352 skipped (7518)`. `pnpm --filter @objectstack/rest typecheck`: exit 0 (tsc, plus the test-layer check). `packages/client` `route-ledger-response-schema.test.ts` + `client-url-conformance.test.ts`: 10/10.

<details><summary>Ablations</summary>

Each mutation went through `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs` on `packages/rest/src/form-routes.ts`. The anchor landed (count 1 → 0), and the file was restored with the blob equal to HEAD (`bd027a8f4c2a`). The suite imports `./rest-server` from `src`, so no dist was involved.

| mutation | red (of 10) |
|:--|:--|
| answer the whole stored row as `fields` (`answer.fields = { ...result.record }`) | 3: the autonumber case, the title+message case, the system-column case |
| type rule removed (`if (typeof type !== 'string' \|\| !RUNTIME_OWNED_FIELD_TYPES.has(type)) continue;` → `void type;`) | 2: the retyped-to-text case and the system-column case |
| value rule removed (`if (typeof value !== 'string' && typeof value !== 'number') continue;` → `void 0;`) | 2: the absent-from-row case and the stored-`null` case |

A first version had a third check (the row has the name as an own key). Its ablation stayed green, because the value rule already drops an absent name. It was folded into the value rule (commit `ba54dc43`), so each remaining check is one an ablation can red.

</details>

<details><summary>Live measure (showcase, --fresh)</summary>

Premise, on `9b1dc992` (main after #28440): an admin authored `probe_case` (a `case_number` autonumber `CASE-{0000}`) and a public form view whose thank-you message names `{{record.case_number}}`. The anonymous submit answered `{"id":"AVTOnpdO_UpgsK3G"}` with HTTP 201, while the stored row read back by the admin carried `"case_number":"CASE-0001"`. The showcase `contact-us` form answered `{"id":…}` too.

After, on `ab25d2a7` (same recipe, fresh boot):
- token form → `{"id":"2nE-CA41J2muTSu-","fields":{"case_number":"CASE-0001"}}` · 201
- `contact-us` (no token) → `{"id":"65dfSz6YqZFzzpvC"}` · 201
- `case_number` retyped to `text` (`PUT /meta/object/probe_case?force=true`), then submitted with `"case_number":"FORGED"` in the body → `{"id":"H1HHBhQH941n-pjM"}` · 201 (the name was dropped)

</details>

## Acceptance notes

- **`fields` is omitted, not `{}`, when every named field is dropped.** The card says `fields` appears "only when it returns at least one". This PR reads that as at least one surviving value, so the body never carries an empty map. A renderer reading `fields?.[name]` sees the same thing either way.
- **A retype's publish gate.** Retyping an `autonumber` to `text` is refused with `409 DESTRUCTIVE_CHANGE` unless forced. After a forced retype, the view that names the field is not re-judged by `thank-you-record-field`, because that rule runs on a `view` or `page` write. The answer-time type rule is what holds that case, as the card intended.
- **Not touched, outside the file surface:** the docblock of `packages/verify/src/handle.ts` (`run`) still says the public form route "answers `{ id }`". It is true for every form whose panel names no field. `content/docs/releases/v18/18-0.mdx` says the same thing and is release-owned.
- **Docs for the panel token itself** (that a thank-you panel may name an autonumber field and the console fills it) belong to the ui half #28444. The console does not fill the tokens yet, so this PR documents only the wire answer.
- Branch `claude/project-thread-c1oruc` is the card thread's platform-assigned branch; claim amendment 6549411063 names it.

## Verification

Local, on `ab25d2a7`: `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack` derived 91 families. Each was run with stdin from `/dev/null`, and its exit was captured by redirect before any pipe. All 91 exit 0. Four first exited non-zero on build state, not on the diff. `check:plugin-teardown-shape --self-test` (exit 3, a shallow clone) was re-run after fetching its pinned fixture commit. `check:skill-examples` (exit 3, no declarations) was re-run after building `@objectstack/client{,-react}`. `check:dts-closure` and `check:dual-build-cjs-loads` (exit 1, packages built with `OS_SKIP_DTS=1`) were re-run after a forced full declarations build of every non-ui package. `--ran`: `91 derived famil(ies) accounted for — 91 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED`, exit 0. Scoped lint, the repo's eslint with `--no-inline-config` over `packages/rest/src`: exit 0. Run record: `server-seat-1/r2026-10-31/out/28443-gates-ran-ab25d2a7.list`.
